title: Chop Suey Club
deck: Web, social and events for a Manhattan gallery of Chinese artists.
lede: Chop Suey Club is a contemporary gallery and design boutique in Manhattan, focused on Chinese artists. We were a founding member of the studio, responsible for design, social media, content strategy, sponsorships and live events.
challenge: Chop Suey Club, a contemporary gallery and design boutique in Manhattan focused on Chinese artists, needed a website, social media and a content strategy, and help with sponsorships and live events.
work: Original work included web design, social media and content strategy, as well as facilitating sponsorships and organizing live events.
credits: Dalton Corr: design, social media, content strategy, sponsorships and live events
